sentences.text: Sri Nitin Srivastava, Advocate has filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the informant.
The same is taken on record.

2. The present application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No. 72 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 of D.P.
Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Baghpat, during the pendency of trial.

3. After arguing the matter at some length, Sri A.S. Usmani, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present application with liberty to the applicant to surrender and apply for regular bail.
4. In view of the above, the present application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
5. Sri V.P. Tripathi, learned A.G.A. for the State is present.

(Vivek Varma,J.) September 2, 2025 Manish Kr  Arun Rexwal vs State Of U.P. on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156391210/
